body:
Thanks @Axmr1 — this is the same root cause as #61284, and your analysis nails it independently.

Both come down to the `/api/pty` keep-alive registry keying **only** on the per-browser `attach` token, so `attach_or_spawn(attach_token, …)` reattaches to the living PTY and throws away the freshly-built `HERMES_TUI_RESUME` env. Same regression lineage (`e10e4bca8`, 0.18.0→0.18.2), same "exactly one resume per dashboard restart" tell.

There's an open PR for it: **#60745**. It takes the same approach you proposed — namespacing the keep-alive identity by the requested resume target — just a bit more complete:

- your patch: `attach_token = f"{attach_token}::{_explicit_resume}"`
- #60745: folds **both** profile and the raw resume into a composite key, `f"{attach_token}\0{profile or ''}\0{raw_resume or ''}"`, and keys on `raw_resume` captured **before** the active-session-file fallback so plain default-`/chat` refresh keep-alive still coalesces.

So your "namespace by resume target" instinct is exactly right; #60745 just also covers the profile axis and the default-`/chat` edge.

This looks like a duplicate of #61284 — the fix is tracked in #60745 (flagging for a maintainer to link/close as they see fit). @Axmr1 if you're running your local patch, #60745 should let you drop it once it lands (no more re-patching after `hermes update`). Worth a review/thumbs-up on the PR if you have a minute, since you've clearly reproduced this end to end.

The root cause here — the `/api/pty` keep-alive registry keying only on the per-browser `attach` token, so a reattach discarded the freshly built `HERMES_TUI_RESUME` env — was fixed by PR #60745 (merged Jul 16, credit @rayjun): the registry key is now the composite `attach\0profile\0resume-target`, so a `?resume=<id>` connection can never coalesce onto a PTY spawned for a different target. The parent→canonical-child variant flagged in review is covered too — the key uses the resolved `HERMES_TUI_RESUME` identity (`registry_resume`), not the raw parent id.

Two follow-ups since have fixed what the reattach bug was masking:
- PR #86332 — the dashboard now requests a full TUI redraw (Ctrl-L) when reusing a keep-alive PTY, so reconnects to long sessions repaint the transcript instead of showing only the recent status rows
- PR #86375 — resumed sessions follow the PTY replay to the bottom of the terminal

Closing as fixed on main. If clicking a previous session still opens a blank new session on a current build (>= the Jul 16 fix), please reopen with the `hermes --version` and the `/api/pty` query string from devtools.
